summary: Terraform provider redfish_certificate resource exposes passphrase in plaintext due to missing Sensitive: true attribute

product.name: terraform-provider-redfish
product.version: all versions (v0.1.0 through v1.6.1 and main)

root_cause.description: The passphrase field in the redfish_certificate resource schema definition is missing the Sensitive: true attribute. This causes Terraform to render the PKCS#12 certificate passphrase in plaintext in plan/apply console output instead of masking it as (sensitive value). The field carries credential material (certificate decryption passphrase) and should be treated identically to password fields, which are correctly marked Sensitive: true elsewhere in the provider.
contributing_factors: Missing Sensitive: true on the passphrase schema field

fix.description: Added Sensitive: true to the passphrase field in the redfish_certificate resource schema, matching the established pattern used by password fields throughout the provider (common.go, provider.go, resource_redfish_user_account.go, etc.).

changes.summary: Added Sensitive: true to the passphrase schema.StringAttribute definition

validation_steps: Verified go build compiles cleanly (exit code 0)
Verified go vet passes with no issues (exit code 0)
Confirmed the Sensitive: true attribute follows existing password field pattern in common.go:76, common.go:116, provider.go:82

error_messages: passphrase field exposed in Terraform plan/apply output
